h: Experts say Nigeria records about 43,000 snakebites and 2,500 deaths yearly
p: Health experts say Nigeria sees around 43,000 snakebites and 2,500 deaths each year, and urge people not to handle snakes and to seek quick treatment after a bite.
more: Delays in reaching hospital are a major cause of death.
Antivenom availability remains limited in rural areas.
